integrity: One complete proof and a standalone finite signed-character verifier. Finite experiments are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns integral homology representations for n>=5; no equivariant space-level homotopy equivalence or n=4 extension is asserted. Rational Specht splitting need not split the integral lattice; unindexed prior equivalents remain possible.
title: Integral automorphism modules of clique-prism neighborhood complexes
